test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which ministry organized the Clean Air Survey Awards and Wetland City Recognition ceremony in September 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** organized a national level workshop and award ceremony in **September** to mark the **International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies**.
 
• During this event, the **Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2024** awards were presented to cities that showed significant improvement in air quality under the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)**.
 
• The ceremony was held in **Jaipur, Rajasthan**, and was presided over by the Union Minister **Shri Bhupender Yadav**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the organizing ministry is correct.***
 
• The event also featured the **Wetland City Accreditation (WCA)** ceremony, recognizing cities for their efforts in the conservation of urban wetlands under the **Ramsar Convention**.
 
• India nominated its first three cities—**Indore**, **Bhopal**, and **Udaipur**—for the prestigious **Wetland City Accreditation**, highlighting the integration of nature into urban planning.
 
• Cities were ranked in three categories based on population: **Category 1** (above 10 lakh), **Category 2** (3 to 10 lakh), and **Category 3** (below 3 lakh). **Surat**, **Jabalpur**, and **Indore** emerged as top performers in the million-plus population category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Swachh Vayu Survekshan (Clean Air Survey):**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the **MoEFCC** to rank **131 cities** in India based on the implementation of activities approved under city action plans and air quality parameters.
 
• The survey promotes **cooperative and competitive federalism** among cities to improve air quality through various measures like dust management, solid waste management, and reducing vehicular emissions.
 
 
 
• **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP):**
 
 
• Launched in **January 2019**, it is a long-term, time-bound, national-level strategy to tackle the air pollution problem across the country.
 
• The target was revised in **2022** to achieve a **40% reduction** in particulate matter (PM10 and PM2.5) concentrations by **2026**.
 
 
 
• **Wetland City Accreditation (WCA):**
 
 
• Established by the **Ramsar Convention** during **COP12 in 2015**, this accreditation recognizes cities that have a supportive relationship with their wetlands.
 
• It encourages cities to promote the conservation and **wise use** of wetlands within their boundaries to provide socio-economic benefits to local populations.
 
• The **three Indian cities** (Indore, Bhopal, Udaipur) nominated for this are known for their historic and ecologically significant water bodies like **Sirpur Wetland** (Indore) and **Bhoj Wetland** (Bhopal).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies:** Observed annually on **September 7**, as designated by the **United Nations General Assembly** in **2019**. The theme for **2024** was **"Invest in #CleanAirNow"**.
 
• **PRANA Portal:** The **Dashboard for Monitoring Implementation of NCAP** is known as **PRANA (Portal for Regulation of Air-pollution in Non-Attainment cities)**, which tracks the physical and financial progress of city action plans.
 
• **Amrit Dharohar:** This is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** in **2023** to promote unique conservation values of **Ramsar Sites** through public participation and eco-tourism.

सही उत्तर पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु
